name: Acts
author: Traditionally Luke, the author of the third Gospel.
date: Covers about AD 30 to 62. Often dated to the 60s or later.
setting: The early church spreads from Jerusalem to Rome.
theme: The risen Christ builds his church through the Holy Spirit, taking the gospel to all nations.

outline.label: The ascension and the replacement of Judas
Judea, Samaria, and the first Gentiles
Philip in Samaria and the Ethiopian
The first journey and the Jerusalem council

christInBook: Acts continues what Jesus began to do and teach (1:1), now through the Spirit and the church. Luke shows the risen Christ ruling from heaven, adding to his church, and bringing the gospel to every nation.
howToRead: Acts follows the plan of 1:8: Jerusalem, Judea and Samaria, and the ends of the earth. Watch for summary statements such as “the word of God continued to increase” that mark each stage.
